# SwipeController

> Detects touch/pointer swipe gestures and dispatches `ui-swipe` with direction and velocity.

## Constructor

```ts
new SwipeController(host: HTMLElement, options?: SwipeOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `threshold` | `number` | no |  |
| `velocityThreshold` | `number` | no |  |
| `axis` | `'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'both'` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-swipe` | `{ direction, distance, velocity }` |

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `destroy()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { SwipeController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new SwipeController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
